items.topic: Record-triggered flow instead of batch class

Gemini Decisions also says the object deduplicates signup records via flow automation.

items.topic: Client owns API error handling and retries
items.statement: Per Gemini notes, Marc advised that the client should handle API error handling on their side because they use a standard Salesforce API that returns status codes and record IDs; Kobi agreed the client can monitor their interface and re-sync records that fail. This is an internal Jumpr position; no client acceptance is recorded in this doc.
